The plate is square, roughly 24 cm across. The scrambled eggs cover about 15% of the plate, a patch of roughly 10 x 15 cm, and they are about 2 cm high. That gives a volume of around 150 cm³ when loosely packed, which I took as about 0.6 density with air gaps, so about 90–100 g. There is also one small dark green leaf, probably a herb, which weighs about 1 g.
